sections.sectionTitle: Section A: National Ethics, Discipline, Rights and Obligations

subtopics.content: Definition and types of values; citizenship meaning, education, obligations, nationalism, national consciousness
subtopics.objective: Define and classify values and their societal importance; understand citizenship, goals of citizenship education, duties of citizens, and nationalism; identify methods of promoting national consciousness, unity, and civic problem-solving.

topics.title: Human Rights, UDHR, Law and Order

subtopics.content: Categories and characteristics of human rights, UDHR history and core freedoms, law and order, constituted authority
subtopics.objective: Understand human rights categories, characteristics, and limitations; examine the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) historical background, core freedoms, and importance; define law, order, features, and types/roles of constituted authority.

topics.title: Responsible Parenthood, Traffic Regulations and Inter-Personal Relationships

subtopics.content: Roles of responsible parents, traffic rules and enforcement, inter-personal and inter-communal conflict resolution
subtopics.objective: Understand responsible parenthood and its impact on national development; study traffic regulations and roles of individuals/government agencies; cultivate interpersonal skills, promote inter-communal relationships, and master conflict resolution skills.

sections.sectionTitle: Section B: Emerging Issues in the Society

topics.title: Cultism, Drugs, Human Trafficking, HIV/AIDS and Youth Empowerment

subtopics.content: Cultism origins/prevention, drug abuse symptoms/agencies, human trafficking, HIV/AIDS prevention/stigma, youth empowerment
subtopics.objective: Identify cult groups, causes, consequences, and prevention strategies; analyze drug abuse causes, addict behaviors, preventive laws, and NDLEA activities; examine causes, effects, and anti-human trafficking efforts; understand HIV/AIDS causes, symptoms, prevention, and anti-stigmatization; evaluate youth empowerment skills and government initiatives.

sections.sectionTitle: Section C: Governmental System and Processes

topics.title: Structure of Government, Democracy, Rule of Law and National Development

subtopics.content: Tiers and functions of government, democratic pillars, rule of law, national development connections
subtopics.objective: Understand tiers and functions of government; examine democracy features, pillars, and challenges; evaluate rule of law principles and importance; demonstrate how democracy and the rule of law foster national development, employment, and good governance.

topics.title: Political Apathy, Civil Society, Popular Participation and Public Service

subtopics.content: Causes/discouragement of political apathy, popular participation, civil society roles, public service challenges/reforms
subtopics.objective: Understand causes and consequences of political apathy and ways to discourage it; evaluate modes of popular participation; examine civil society functions, qualities, and operational limitations; analyze public service functions, shortcomings, and strategies for improvement.
